journey.title: Tabbing out of the navigation closes the open dropdown
journey.goal: After a keyboard user leaves the navigation, the Shop dropdown no longer covers the page

steps.title: Tab out of the navigation to search

functionalJourney.title: Open the Shop dropdown with the pointer

guards.title: Escape closes the Shop dropdown and returns focus to Shop
guards.goal: Escape inside the dropdown closes it

plan.root_cause: The disclosure menu does not close when keyboard focus moves outside of the menu (e.g., tabbing from the last menu item to the next page element). The menu relies on click and Escape to close, but lacks a focusout handler to close the submenu when focus leaves.
plan.repair_strategy: Add a focusout event listener on the menu element that checks if the related target is outside the menu; if so, and the menu is top-level with an open controller, close the controller and clear focus state.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: When a keyboard user tabs out of the navigation, the Shop dropdown will close (aria-expanded becomes false and the submenu is hidden), satisfying the requirement that the dropdown does not cover the page after navigation.
functional_risks: Potential risk of closing the menu when focus temporarily leaves due to programmatic focus shifts or when using assistive technology that moves focus outside unexpectedly; however, the check ensures the menu only closes when focus moves to a node not descended from the menu, which is appropriate.
Ensure that submenus are not inadvertently closed when moving between sibling items (they remain inside). Risk low.
verification_requirements: Tabbing from the Shop button into the dropdown and then to the Search input results in the Shop button having aria-expanded="false" and the Plants link being hidden.
Pressing Escape while the dropdown is open closes it and returns focus to the Shop button (existing guard).
Clicking the Shop button still opens and closes the dropdown correctly.
Navigating within the dropdown with arrow keys (if optional support enabled) continues to work.
Menu remains open when moving focus between menu items (e.g., from Shop button to Plants link to Tools link).

plan.root_cause: The disclosure menu does not close when keyboard focus moves outside of the menu (e.g., tabbing from the last menu item to the next page element). The menu relies on click and Escape to close, but lacks a focusout handler to close the submenu when focus leaves. Additionally, the previous attempt incorrectly used `this.elements.controller.close()` but the top-level menu has no controller; it has submenu toggles.
plan.repair_strategy: Add a focusout event listener on the menu element that checks if the related target is outside the menu; if so, close all open submenu toggles via `closeChildren()` and clear focus state.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: When a keyboard user tabs out of the navigation, the Shop dropdown will close (aria-expanded becomes false and the submenu is hidden), satisfying the requirement that the dropdown does not cover the page after navigation.
functional_risks: Potential risk of closing the menu when focus temporarily leaves due to programmatic focus shifts or when using assistive technology that moves focus outside unexpectedly; however, the check ensures the menu only closes when focus moves to a node not descended from the menu, which is appropriate.
Ensure that submenus are not inadvertently closed when moving between sibling items (they remain inside). Risk low.
